projects.name: Echo UI v3
projects.longDescription: Echo UI is a comprehensive component library and design system built for modern web applications. It provides a cohesive set of accessible, customizable components that help teams ship beautiful interfaces faster while maintaining consistency across their products.
projects.additionalDescription: Building Echo UI taught me the importance of developer experience. Every component was designed with both the end user and the developer in mind — clear APIs, comprehensive documentation, and sensible defaults that can be easily overridden. The result is a system that teams actually want to use.
highlights: Built 50+ accessible components following WAI-ARIA guidelines
Created a flexible theming system with CSS variables and Tailwind
Implemented comprehensive Storybook documentation with interactive examples
Achieved 98% test coverage with unit and integration tests

projects.name: JustOS
projects.longDescription: JustOS is a productivity operating system designed specifically for creators and makers. It combines task management, note-taking, and project planning into a unified workspace that adapts to how creative professionals actually work.
projects.additionalDescription: The biggest challenge with JustOS was balancing flexibility with simplicity. Creators need tools that can adapt to their unique workflows, but they also need to be able to start working immediately without a steep learning curve. We solved this with a modular architecture that reveals complexity gradually.
highlights: Designed a modular workspace system with customizable layouts
Built real-time collaboration features using WebSockets
Implemented offline-first architecture with automatic sync
Created a plugin system for extending functionality

projects.name: Happy Stats
projects.longDescription: Happy Stats is a lightweight analytics dashboard built for developers who want clear insights without complex setup. It visualizes metrics like commits, deployments, and project activity in a fast, privacy-friendly way.
projects.additionalDescription: Beyond the technical build, Happy Stats was also an exercise in product thinking. I wanted to design analytics that developers would actually enjoy using — clear typography, instant feedback, and no unnecessary clutter. Every chart was tested against real-world commit data to make sure it told a story at a glance. Building it reminded me how powerful simple, focused tools can be when they're made by someone who uses them every day.
highlights: Built a modular charting system using Recharts for clean, customizable visuals
Designed a real-time update flow powered by Supabase subscriptions
Implemented role-based dashboards for teams and solo developers
Optimized queries for large datasets using PostgreSQL window functions

projects.name: Cactus Plant
projects.longDescription: Cactus Plant is a realtime collaboration framework for building multiplayer experiences. It abstracts away the complexity of conflict resolution, presence awareness, and state synchronization, letting developers focus on building features.
projects.additionalDescription: The hardest part of building Cactus Plant was handling edge cases — network partitions, out-of-order messages, and conflicting edits. We spent months perfecting our CRDT implementation to ensure that no matter what happens, data is never lost and conflicts are resolved deterministically.
highlights: Implemented CRDT-based conflict resolution for seamless collaboration
Built a presence system showing real-time cursor positions and selections
Created an efficient binary protocol reducing bandwidth by 70%
Designed horizontal scaling architecture supporting 100k+ concurrent users

projects.name: Stellar
projects.longDescription: Stellar is a comprehensive platform for space exploration and astronomy enthusiasts. It brings the cosmos closer with interactive visualizations, real-time satellite tracking, and educational content that makes astronomy accessible to everyone.
projects.additionalDescription: Space has always fascinated me, and Stellar was my way of sharing that passion. The challenge was taking complex astronomical data and presenting it in a way that feels magical rather than overwhelming. Every visualization is designed to inspire wonder while remaining scientifically accurate.
highlights: Created interactive 3D visualizations using Three.js and WebGL
Integrated NASA and ESA APIs for real-time space data
Built a custom physics engine for accurate orbital mechanics
Designed an educational mode with guided tours of the solar system

projects.name: Neobase
projects.longDescription: Neobase is a next-generation database solution that combines the flexibility of NoSQL with the reliability of traditional relational databases. It is designed for modern applications that need to scale without compromising on data integrity.
projects.additionalDescription: Building a database from scratch taught me more about computer science fundamentals than any course ever could. From implementing B-trees to designing a query optimizer, every component required deep understanding of data structures and algorithms. The result is a database that is both powerful and approachable.
highlights: Designed a hybrid storage engine supporting both document and relational models
Implemented ACID transactions with optimistic concurrency control
Built a query language that combines SQL familiarity with JSON flexibility
Created automatic indexing based on query pattern analysis

projects.name: Charter
projects.longDescription: Charter democratizes legal services by making contract creation, review, and management accessible to everyone. Using AI-powered analysis, it helps individuals and small businesses understand legal documents without expensive attorney fees.
projects.additionalDescription: Legal language has historically been a barrier that keeps everyday people from understanding their rights. Charter was built to break down that barrier. Every feature was designed with non-lawyers in mind, translating complex legal jargon into plain English while maintaining legal accuracy.
highlights: Built an AI-powered contract analysis engine using NLP
Created a library of 100+ customizable legal templates
Implemented clause-by-clause explanations in plain English
Designed a collaborative review workflow for teams

projects.name: Echo
projects.longDescription: Echo is a revolutionary audio platform that combines high-fidelity streaming with social features. It creates a space where audiophiles can discover new music, share their collections, and connect with others who share their passion for sound quality.
projects.additionalDescription: Audio quality is often sacrificed for convenience in modern streaming. Echo was built on the premise that listeners should not have to choose. We developed custom audio codecs and adaptive streaming that deliver studio-quality sound without buffering, even on slower connections.
highlights: Developed lossless audio streaming with adaptive bitrate
Built a social graph connecting listeners with similar tastes
Created a custom audio visualizer using Web Audio API
Implemented gapless playback for seamless album listening

projects.name: Plasma
projects.longDescription: Plasma is a cutting-edge energy management system that helps businesses optimize their power consumption and reduce costs. Through intelligent monitoring, predictive analytics, and automated controls, it makes sustainable energy management effortless.
projects.additionalDescription: Energy waste is often invisible, making it easy to ignore. Plasma was designed to make energy consumption tangible and actionable. Real-time visualizations show exactly where energy goes, while AI-powered recommendations identify savings opportunities that would otherwise go unnoticed.
highlights: Built real-time monitoring with IoT sensor integration
Implemented ML-based consumption prediction with 95% accuracy
Created automated demand response for peak load management
Designed ROI calculators for sustainability investments

projects.name: Scalar
projects.longDescription: Scalar creates beautiful, interactive API documentation that developers love. It makes it easy to create, maintain, and share comprehensive API documentation with your team, transforming OpenAPI specs into stunning documentation pages.
projects.additionalDescription: Documentation is often an afterthought, but it is the first thing developers see when evaluating an API. Scalar was built on the belief that great documentation should be effortless to create and a pleasure to read. Every design decision was made with both the documentation author and the API consumer in mind.
highlights: Built an OpenAPI 3.1 parser with comprehensive spec validation
Created an interactive API playground for testing endpoints
Implemented automatic code generation in 10+ programming languages
Designed a theming system matching any brand identity

projects.name: Sonic
projects.longDescription: Sonic is a lightning-fast data processing engine built for real-time analytics. It handles massive datasets with ease, delivering insights in milliseconds rather than minutes. Perfect for applications where speed is critical.
projects.additionalDescription: Performance was not just a feature for Sonic — it was the entire product. Every line of code was scrutinized for efficiency. We used memory-mapped files, SIMD instructions, and custom data structures to squeeze every bit of performance from the hardware.
highlights: Achieved sub-millisecond query latency on billion-row datasets
Built a columnar storage engine optimized for analytical queries
Implemented vectorized query execution for maximum throughput
Created a distributed architecture for horizontal scaling

projects.name: Streamline
projects.longDescription: Streamline automates your business processes by connecting your tools and eliminating repetitive tasks. With a visual workflow builder and hundreds of integrations, it empowers teams to focus on work that matters.
projects.additionalDescription: Automation should feel empowering, not intimidating. We designed Streamline with non-technical users in mind, using visual metaphors and natural language descriptions that make complex workflows accessible. The goal was to give everyone superpowers.
highlights: Built a visual workflow editor with drag-and-drop simplicity
Created 200+ pre-built integrations with popular business tools
Implemented conditional logic and branching for complex workflows
Designed a monitoring dashboard with detailed execution logs

projects.name: Relative
projects.longDescription: Relative helps you discover and visualize your family history. Build comprehensive family trees, share stories across generations, and connect with relatives you never knew existed. Your heritage, beautifully mapped.
projects.additionalDescription: Family history is more than names and dates — it is stories, traditions, and connections that span generations. Relative was designed to capture all of that richness. Every feature encourages users to go beyond the basic tree and bring their ancestors to life.
highlights: Created an interactive tree visualization supporting thousands of relatives
Built collaborative editing so families can build trees together
Implemented smart matching to suggest potential family connections
Designed a timeline view showing family events across generations

projects.name: Bloom
projects.longDescription: Bloom is a sustainable beauty brand platform that connects eco-conscious consumers with clean beauty products. It combines e-commerce with education, helping customers make informed choices about what they put on their skin.
projects.additionalDescription: The beauty industry is full of greenwashing and misleading claims. Bloom was built to cut through the noise with transparent ingredient lists, verified sustainability credentials, and honest product reviews. Trust is the foundation of everything we built.
highlights: Built an ingredient transparency system with safety ratings
Created a product comparison tool for informed purchasing
Implemented sustainability scoring based on verified criteria
Designed a community reviews system with verified purchases
